snippet.title: Dream City Psyche Version 1.660 (15 Minutes Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Dream City Psyche is an open world investigation focused urban role playing game. You're a psychic born with a mission to find your missing uncle on a small island, Dream City. Investigate murders, find missing journal entries and unlock psychic abilities to unravel entities from another dimension.

The game can be purchased from Play Store or itchio website:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.inspiregamesnexus.dreamcitylifefull
https://edykajang.itch.io/dream-city-psyche
